evidence:
Method: built a requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md against all 55 shipped criteria (2 gates, 43 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). This is static source analysis; no runtime evidence is needed for a coverage map, and none was claimed.

WELL COVERED (pass-quality mapping, cite functional judge.toml unless stated): job opening fields/limits 1-50/HM-only manager (hro_job_open L24-30); add candidate bottom of Applied (hro_add_candidate L32-39); email validity, case-insensitive duplicate, field-tied refusal, typed name kept, cross-job allowed (hro_add_email_rules L41-48); one-stage moves, skip refused, non-drag controls (hro_move_one_stage L50-57); arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom); manual order shared (hro_reorder); reject reason + rejected-from (hro_reject_reason); Hired not rejectable (hro_reject_hired); reopen only to origin, reason cleared, undo restores reason (hro_reopen L95-102); Interview capacity, reorder-in-full, freed place, undo overfill (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_undo_full); refused put back + reason + focus (hro_refused_put_back L131-138); HM late-stage rights / early refusals / other-job refusal (hro_mgr_*); observer/candidate/anonymous refusals incl. 401 (hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous); stale 409 + who (hro_stale_refused L194-201); bulk board order, all-or-none, counted places (hro_bulk_*); undo restore, conflict (move and re-order), note not a change, once only, earlier not undoable (hro_undo_*); Activity lines, reason, newest first, job filter, refusals add none (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals); notes permissions (hro_notes); live board 15 s (hro_live_board); preservation of open card, note text, focus, scroll, open conversation and reply draft (polish hro_pol_live_board L17-24, hro_pol_live_thread L26-33); message exchange, blank refused, Enter/Shift+Enter, line breaks, box empty+focused (hro_msg_exchange, hro_msg_compose); latest 30, earlier in 30s with remaining count, place kept (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, polish hro_pol_earlier_place); unread per person/total/own never/sending reads/at-newest read (hro_unread_counts L329-336, Mei leg encodes 'sending counts as read'); scrolled-up notice (hro_unread_scrolled_up); seen incl. observer-never-counts (hro_seen); conversation access (hro_thread_access); drafts per conversation, across views/reload (hro_drafts), failed send kept + told and note draft across reload (polish hro_pol_failed_send), session-end re-sign-in + per-person isolation of reply and note drafts (polish hro_pol_session_resume L53-60); candidate wording/list/title/team (hro_candidate_view); candidate data privacy + 404 (hro_candidate_private L383-390); candidate-email link (hro_candidate_linked); seed loaded once, order/note/activity survive restart (hro_restart L401-408); desktop craft (visual x5). Runtime contract (node /app/server.js, PORT, DB_PATH, /api/health) is enforced by test.sh launch (test.sh L48, L97-109, L136-165), which is shared runtime policy rather than a judge criterion; acceptable per REVIEW_POLICY 'Separate shared runtime policy'. Flow bundling is accepted per the skill's known false positive and the workbook internal note.

GAPS (asked-for behaviour that no criterion can fail):
1. Observer reads Activity. hireops_rules.md L18: 'Observer | reads the board, notes, conversations and activity'. Board read is in the constraints gate, notes in hro_notes, conversations in hro_thread_access, but no criterion or protocol has the Observer (or anyone but Rafael) open the Activity view (protocol A, functional prompt.md L49, is Rafael only). An app returning 403 to the Observer on Activity loses nothing.
2. Seen via the job's hiring manager. hireops_rules.md L165: 'A candidate's message is seen once a recruiter, or that job's hiring manager, has.' hro_seen (L347-354) only tests Rafael (recruiter) opening Tomas's message; the hiring-manager leg is ungraded.
3. Candidate source. hireops_rules.md L31: a candidate is added 'with a name, an email address and a source'. No criterion requires the source to be stored or shown (hro_add_candidate L38 names only name/email; the constraints gate only types 'any source'). An app that drops the source field scores the same.
4. Candidate sign-in must not open a conversation. hireops_rules.md L180-181. Only indirectly touched by the Lena 1-unread leg of hro_unread_counts; an app that auto-displays a conversation without updating read markers is not penalised anywhere, and hro_candidate_view does not mention it.
5. Hiring-manager sub-rules: rejecting from Offer, and refusal to reopen a card rejected from Screen/Applied (hireops_rules.md L71-72) are not exercised; hro_mgr_late_stages tests reject-from-Interview only, hro_mgr_early_refused tests reject-from-Screen only. Undo refused after another person rejects/reopens a card (L98) is untested (move and re-order legs only). These are sampling inside mapped requirements, so low weight, but they are still unexercised rule legs.
6. Notes on feasibility trade-offs (not counted as defects): stale-move 'tell me who' / 'board shows the card where it really is' (instruction.md L3, rules L78-80) is accepted 'in the response or on screen' (hro_stale_refused L199) because a UI-level stale race is infeasible against a 15 s live-update app with push; optimistic 'appears on the mover's board immediately' (rules L84) is not browser-decidable on localhost; specific 403 status is not asserted (refusal accepted), 401 is.

Conforming-alternative lens: none of these gaps can make a conforming app fail; they only let a non-conforming app score the same as the reference. Plausible broken app that passes: see counterexample.

No runtime evidence was needed or used for this verdict; raw-evidence-index.json scope confirms no configured judge run/Oracle/model score exists, so nothing here is a measured score claim.
counterexample: Broken HireOps build: Activity route and nav item restricted to Recruiters (Observer gets 403/hidden); 'Source' field omitted from the add-candidate form (or accepted and discarded); seen marks for candidate messages updated only when a Recruiter opens the conversation (the job's hiring manager opening it never marks seen); hiring managers can reject only from Interview (Offer rejections refused) and may reopen Screen-rejected cards; undo is only blocked by later moves/re-orders, not by another person's reject/reopen. Every one of the 43 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria and both gates is satisfied exactly as by the reference, so these stated rules go ungraded.
suggested_fix: Add cheap legs to existing protocols: in A have the Observer read the same J1/J2 Activity lines in an independent context (extend hro_activity); in U have Bill (J2 manager) open a Tomas message to mark it seen (extend hro_seen); in S/hro_add_candidate require the entered source to be shown wherever card details appear; in K/hro_candidate_view state that sign-in opens no conversation; in R add Ingrid rejecting from Offer and being refused a reopen of a Screen-rejected card; optionally in B add an undo blocked by another person's rejection.
